description: Figure 19 is a bar chart that illustrates the average probing accuracy using different MLP (multilayer perceptron) variations. The chart has a vertical axis representing the probing accuracy, which is a measure of how well the model can predict the correct output given a set of inputs. The horizontal axis is labeled with different MLP variations, each indicated by the size of the hidden layer(s) in square brackets. The bars in the chart are grouped by the MLP variation, with each group consisting of bars that represent the probing accuracy for each hidden layer within that MLP variation. The bars are color-coded, with each color representing a different hidden layer. The chart does not provide specific numerical values for the probing accuracy, but it shows a general trend of how the probing accuracy changes with different MLP variations and hidden layer sizes.
